fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 4% of Gross Revenues for weeks 1–52; increases to 6% (or $100/week minimum, ~$400/month) from week 53 through end of term. Advertising Fee is 4% of Gross Revenues but currently only 1% is collected (3% uncollected). Local Advertising Expenditure requires minimum 1% of Gross Revenues spent locally per quarter (currently not collected). Franchisees purchasing existing company-owned or affiliated salons pay 6% (or $100/week minimum) for the entire term. Electronic Communications Fee up to $500/year. Gift Card ACH Monthly Settlement Service Fee of $10/month per bank account.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Fees(2)(3) Weeks 1 through 52: 4% of Gross Revenues(3) Week 53 through end of Franchise Agreement Term: 6% of Gross Revenues or $100 per week, whichever is greater

Advertising Fees(2)(3) 4% of Gross Revenues (currently 1% is collected and 3% is uncollected)

Local Advertising Expenditure The difference by which 1% of Gross Revenues for the preceding quarter exceeds your actual expenditure toward local advertising for the preceding quarter. Currently this is not collected.
